author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A 20-year-old Hopkinton resident was airlifted to Rhode Island Hospital after a vehicle crashed into a tree on Route 216 in Ashaway, according to local police.

NBC 10 reported that an officer observed the northbound vehicle traveling at high speed. Police said the officer activated emergency lights in an effort to get the driver to slow down, but the vehicle continued. The officer then traveled in the same direction and found it against a large tree near Trinity Lutheran Church.

The driver was conscious when emergency crews arrived but had significant injuries, police said. Firefighters and medical personnel worked at the scene before the patient was flown to the Providence trauma center.

Hopkinton police said the crash remains under investigation. Officials had not released the driver’s name or described any citation or charge in the report. The inquiry will need to establish the vehicle’s path, speed and other circumstances before investigators can reach conclusions about what caused it to leave the roadway.
dek: Police said a 20-year-old resident suffered serious injuries after a vehicle left the road near Trinity Lutheran Church in Ashaway.
headline: Hopkinton driver airlifted after Route 216 tree crash
